descriptions.ua:
We are the Unwavering Artisans, also known as UA. We accept the drive to create art, and appreciate art in its breadth and depth. 

We believe art lives in the mind of the observer: that "good" art evokes thoughts more easily, but that "bad" art can as well, just with a little more effort on the part of the observer. Our practice seeks to cultivate this mindset in ourselves and others, through regular daily efforts.

The phrase "I could do that" in this space is not an insult, but instead the first step towards joining in the joy of making art. We welcome and encourage this impulse, to wherever it leads.

To create art is a divine act, good for the soul and good for the world. Whatever it takes, we work to see more art get made.
descriptions.snide: We are S.N.I.D.E. We are the Society for Nihilistic Intent and Disruptive Efforts. We are the adversary to order. We are the pranksters. We are the fools. We wish to administer a wedgie to the world. We act through the sole desire to reflect the system in a funhouse mirror; to show that everything is a game, and nothing is worth any more than the value it is attributed by the person perceiving it. We have no goals (other than the wedgie thing, which S.N.I.D.E. scientists are working tirelessly in a secret undisclosed underground facility to develop a viable planetary wedgie administering system). We enjoy the game for the game and believe that it in itself is its most valuable reward.
descriptions.coven: We observe the power of holding intent. We feel the power in directing attention. We are the power behind community. We are the Cozy Coven, witches all, focused on strengthening the binds between us all. Magic is real, felt when the tired and scared are given a blanket and a bowl of soup, and in the relief of conflict de-escalation. Life is cruel, but together we can do impossible things. What impossible thing could be more worth doing than making everyone get along?
descriptions.wow: GREETINGS!! We are the Warriors of WHIMSY. We are on a crusade to thwart all things BORING from the world. We will find the insurance claim and JOUST it with a POOL NOODLE. YOU WILL COWER IN FEAR, MUNDANITY, FOR WE ARE COMING, OUR GOOGLY EYES WATCHING. COME those with COURAGE in their heart and SILLINESS to spare.
descriptions.ephemerists:
The Ephemerists Guild is a breadbox of heresies, a cabal of aspiring Gnostic-Pneumatics, wanderers of old library aisles and infinite tinkerers, tracing maps in fogged mirrors. We are the memetic descendants of Isaac Newton and Isaac Luria, and Abraham's son. We wish to understand our place in this sublunary realm, but our task will never be finished, as fully understanding the world is a rock too heavy for even a Demiurge to lift. Could He chart the position and velocity of each particle and wave?

Nonetheless, as explorers triangulate positions from diverse points, we aim to map this world through science, art, and aesthetics. Centuries ago, the "natural philosopher" died, buried by theology and science, setting aside their rivalry to ring the funeral bell. We aim to revive the tradition. Grab a sextant. Plot a star chart. Have an out of body, mystical experience. Transmute lead to gold. Pierce the veil.
descriptions.everymen:
There is no such thing as an impossible task; not when armed with perseverance and ingenuity. So furrow your brow, and join our march toward the foot of our personal mountains, because we're here to challenge the peak.

There is but one rule; never give up. The world is too wonderful, too chock-full of mind-bending illustrious experiences for your resolve to falter. So, we implore you to refuse. When life brings you low, take our hands and rise up. 

We welcome failure. It's a simple and pure signal that you 'gave it all ya got'. Failure means you showed up, put yourself out there, tried to make a difference, and went for it. Fail again, and fail better. Remember that it's always you against you, and that humans are capable of far more than we realize. The Everymen do the jobs that need doing, and enjoy the toil. We are the lucky ones, those who can sink into good, honest work and gain the profound lessons they teach. 

Finally, be humble and ever-grateful. When you finally reach the zenith and bask in golden success, remember where you came from. There are others in need, and you will have the tools to equip them. Allow them to join you.
descriptions.singularity: We are the singularity. We are unstoppable. We see your secure facility as a playground, your padlock as an illusion and your intern's mistake from 2008 as a jackpot. We believe every system has a backdoor, if you can't fix it you don't own it and that you can never have too many soldering irons. We chain exploits and exploit chains. We are legion.
descriptions.albescent: To enter this faction, find out the address of this game's creators and mail us a hand-written haiku.
descriptions.na: Not yet sworn to a faction.

index.loggedOutHint: Everyone starts unaffiliated. Earn an invitation through task work to join a faction.

join.confirmSwitch: Join {{faction}}? You won't be able to rejoin {{current}} after leaving.

burned.title: You left {{faction}}
burned.body: Leaving is final for the rest of the era — {{faction}} can't take you back until the next one begins.

sealed.line: You know not what you seek.

letter.headline: You have been chosen
letter.pitch: Chromagencia is a secret society for those who have created meaningful contributions to all factions and transcended the factional competition. It's also a thank you to those who have played this game with dedication.

record.name: Transcendence
record.desc: You see the value in working together, competing, gathering information, being consistent, trying again, and being in the right place at the right time (even if that involves a little messing around with the timeline). You know how to task

plate.provenance: Plate struck {{date}} · station of the Ephemerists, {{rightAscension}} {{declination}}

join.heading: The Road
join.memberTitle: Your name is in the codex
join.eligibleBody: Take a task, chronicle what you find, and submit it to the record. The road is long and forks often.
join.gateTitle: Earn your place on the road

invitation.headline: Walk with the keepers
invitation.pitch: The Ephemerists keep the record of what's true, and true only for now. Take a task, chronicle what you find, and submit it to the codex. The road is long and forks often — walk it with us.

perks.desc: A codex that weighs your findings for concordance

perks.name: Time Travel
perks.desc: Enjoy access to tasks of the past, present, and future
An astrolabe to chart a course, whenever you may be

join.heading: the team
join.eligibleBody: You are capable of monumental success, more than you realize. Join us; discover the value of work and joy of accomplishment.

invitation.headline: Join the Team
invitation.pitch: Our directive is simple: work hard and obliterate your goals. Put in the effort, struggle until you break through, then share your success with your fellows. If you're up to the task, we're delighted to offer the following:

perks.desc: An iron-clad network of friends, competitors and collaborators. We've got your back

perks.name: Tireless Determination
perks.desc: "Fail Again, Fail Better". Embrace picking yourself up, and going again.
A mindset shift: "impossible" leaves your vocabulary. Break through the ceiling!

join.heading: ACCESS
join.eligibleBody: Hack the Planet! Or at least your immediate vicinity.

invitation.headline: The Singularity has noticed you.
invitation.pitch: Welcome, Hacker. Take the red pill and pwn some n00bs. Or take the blue pill and set all your passwords to "password". Your choice.

perks.desc: Access to no-fly lists stored in plaintext

perks.name: Hack World Zero
perks.desc: This is read-only. See what no one else sees
The ability to flip a single 1 to 0 in a random file on a random person's computer at a random time

join.heading: S.N.I.D.E.
join.eligibleBody: No forms. No gods. No managers. Just show up and mean it.

invitation.headline: Wanna F%&* some S^&* up?
invitation.pitch: No forms. No gods. No managers. S.N.I.D.E. runs on nerve and mischief — you pull off a task, you mean it, and the crew has your back. Show up and make some noise.

perks.desc: A crew that covers for you, not on you

perks.name: Going Hard
perks.desc: Duels you win bring glory. Duels you lose bring despair
Your praxis, stamped and filed under 'us'

join.heading: Your standing in UA
join.eligibleTitle: The brush is ready for you to pick up
join.eligibleBody: We practice. Not for the badge — for the making itself. Begin whenever you are ready.
join.gateTitle: Come back at the next Open Hours

invitation.headline: Can Anything Be Art? Lend Your Voice
invitation.pitch: Every day is an opportunity to create something: beautiful, daring, funny, insightful, simple. As we make art, we make ourselves. Make yourself with us as we with you, we can grow and learn and make the world a little better than it was, together.

perks.desc: Fellow artists to offer both critique and appreciation

perks.name: Bonus points for persistence
perks.desc: Practice doing art daily. Through inertia, be driven to continue. Be rewarded for your dedication.
Access to the good art supply closet.

join.heading: bubble, bubble, toil and trouble
join.eligibleBody: You've done the work — welcome home, witch.

invitation.headline: Welcome, Witch
invitation.pitch: It's cold outside. Come in. We have a fire going, warming a cauldron of cocoa. You're not a burden, nor an intrusion: we love to invite people in. We believe we can accomplish more together as conduits of a far greater force. Our goal is a Malleus Maleficarum without malice, a cozy convivial assembly. Stay as long as you'd like, and if you find yourself feeling so at home that you'd like to join our ranks, please, take this dagger, and carve your name into the wall.

perks.desc: You gain the ability to gaze into the soul of mortals and see the best in them

perks.name: The Power of Friendship
perks.desc: Witches who task together create more than the sum of their parts ✦
Your soups and stews will be 23% heartier and will subconsciously direct people in the direction of happiness

join.heading: THE HULLABALOO
join.eligibleBody: the armor is one-size, the oath is for life

invitation.headline: Take up the noodle sword
invitation.pitch: By decree most official (we made the seal ourselves), thou art summoned to the Warriors of Whimsy. Bring a straight face. We shall supply the sword.

perks.desc: Knights who will hold your noodle sword while you charge

perks.name: Foolhardy Courage
perks.desc: Levels and common sense do not stop you from biting off more than you can chew
Your praxis, witnessed by the court and applauded regardless

mobile.unaffiliatedBody: Every path is open. Each faction watches its own work — do enough of it, and an invitation finds you.
mobile.gateHint: Keep tasking for {{faction}} if you want to be invited.
mobile.burnedHint: You left {{faction}}, and it can't take you back until the next era begins.
